item.isekai_mahou.arcane_lens.tooltip: Hold right-click to observe a phenomenon.
item.isekai_mahou.arcane_lens.tooltip2: Aim at blocks, creatures, the sky, or just study the place.
item.isekai_mahou.research_note.hint: Place it in a Research Table to write Theses.
block.isekai_mahou.research_table.toolti: Complete Theses by linking runes made from Research Notes.
message.isekai_mahou.mage.restudied: You deepened your study of %s (+1 note).
message.isekai_mahou.mage.cooldown: You already studied %s today. Come back tomorrow.
message.isekai_mahou.mage.need_paper: Not enough paper on the table (%s needed).
message.isekai_mahou.mage.need_shelves: Not enough bookshelves near the table (%s/%s).
message.isekai_mahou.mage.need_notes: The notes on the table are not enough for the placed runes.
message.isekai_mahou.mage.circuit_invali: The rune circuit is not complete yet.
command.isekai_mahou.mage.reveal: All phenomena were revealed in the Atlas.
screen.isekai_mahou.research_table.rerol: Generates a new grid layout. Costs 1 paper.
screen.isekai_mahou.research_table.choos: Choose a thesis from the list.
screen.isekai_mahou.research_table.statu: Open circuit: link the entry to the exit.
Some runes are outside the circuit.

Not enough paper on the table.
Use it as a bridge for bonus XP.
Fissure: nothing can be written here.
screen.isekai_mahou.research_table.thesi: Reward: Arcane Essence and Mana Crystal
screen.isekai_mahou.research_table.help1: 1. Choose a thesis and put notes and paper on the table.
screen.isekai_mahou.research_table.help2: 2. Pick a rune on the right and click the grid to write it.
screen.isekai_mahou.research_table.help3: 3. Link the entry rune (gold frame) to the exit rune (silver frame) through adjacent cells.
screen.isekai_mahou.research_table.help4: 4. Neighbors must match: same element, two base elements, or a fusion and its parents.
screen.isekai_mahou.research_table.help5: 5. Arcane matches everything. Fixed runes used as bridges give +15%% XP.
screen.isekai_mahou.mage_atlas.title: Arcane Atlas
screen.isekai_mahou.mage_atlas.select: Pick a phenomenon to see its details.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.lava.desc: Molten rock pulsing with the heat of the world's depths. Observe a lava pool.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.magma_block.desc: Stone holding embers within: Fire and Earth fused. Common in the Nether and on the sea floor.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.obsidian.desc: Born when water meets lava. As hard as an archmage's will.
Violet tears flow from the stone. Look in ruined portals and bastions.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.ice.desc: Water lulled to sleep by the cold wind. Frozen lakes and snowy biomes.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.blue_ice.desc: Ice so ancient it became an element of its own. Icebergs and frozen peaks.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.amethyst.desc: Crystals singing with light trapped in the earth. Underground geodes.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.sculk.desc: A living mass that feeds on souls and hears every step. Deep caves.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.ancient_debris.d: Metal forged by the Nether itself. Rare, deep in the Nether.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.prismarine.desc: Sea stone that shifts color with the tides. Ocean monuments.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.moss.desc: Patient life covering stone. Lush caves and damp forests.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.powder_snow.desc: Snow so light it swallows whoever steps on it. Snowy slopes.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.glowstone.desc: Crystallized light hanging from the Nether's ceiling.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.soul_fire.desc: Blue flames fed by souls trapped in sand. Soul Sand Valley.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.dripstone.desc: Earth dripping drop by drop, carving stone spears. Dripstone caves.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.enchanting_table: The ancients already etched pure mana into books. Study an enchanting table.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.beacon.desc: A pillar of light touching the sky, powered by a star.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.end_portal_frame: A frame stitching this world to the Void. Hidden in strongholds.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.conduit.desc: The heart of the sea beating inside a prismarine cage.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.spawner.desc: A cage that conjures monsters endlessly. Dungeons and trial chambers.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.mana_crystal_blo: Solidified pure mana. Used in Ascension circles.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.void_crystal.des: Black crystal that drinks the light around it. Grows in the Abyss.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.ember_rock.desc: Glowing stone from the Ember Isles of the Elemental Plane.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.blaze.desc: A fire spirit spinning around burning rods. Nether fortresses.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.enderman.desc: Crosses space like taking a step. Don't stare at it for long.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.warden.desc: The blind guardian of the depths. Observe it from afar, in silence.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.slime.desc: Living jelly that splits when hurt. Swamps and deep caves.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.magma_cube.desc: The slime's burning cousin. Basalt deltas and fortresses.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.phantom.desc: Haunts the sky of those who do not sleep.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.ghast.desc: A floating creature that weeps fire. Nether skies.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.iron_golem.desc: Metal animated by the will to protect. Villages.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.allay.desc: A blue spirit that loves music. Outposts and mansions.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.breeze.desc: Wind that gained a body and a will. Trial chambers.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.evoker.desc: An illager mage conjuring fangs and vexes. Mansions and raids.
Black bones that wither all they touch. Nether fortresses.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.guardian.desc: A one-eyed fish that fires beams. Ocean monuments.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.shulker.desc: Its shots cancel the body's weight. End cities.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.glow_squid.desc: Living light swimming in the dark of underground waters.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.snow_golem.desc: Snow and a pumpkin: the simplest of golems.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.witch.desc: Lonely alchemist of the swamps. Beware the potions.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.strider.desc: Walks on lava as if it were a calm lake.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.tensura_slime.de: A friendly slime of this world. Some say it can even learn magic.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.goblin.desc: Small, cunning and always in packs. Goblin villages.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.salamander.desc: The lesser spirit of Fire, born in embers.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.undine.desc: The lesser spirit of Water, dancing in the waves.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.sylph.desc: The lesser spirit of Wind, too fast for the eye.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.fairy.desc: Glows among flowers near enchanted lakes.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.wandering_spirit: Ownerless mana wandering through the night.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.storm_hawk.desc: A bird that dives between lightning bolts.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.desert.desc: Earth dried grain by grain by the wind. Deserts and badlands.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.peaks.desc: Where earth touches the wind. Climb the highest peaks.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.deep_dark.desc: A silence so dense you can touch it. Far below the surface.
An island where no monster spawns. Search in the middle of the ocean.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.deep_ocean.desc: Water so deep that light gives up on the way.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.swamp.desc: Still water and soft earth, where witches make their home.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.cherry_grove.des: Pink petals dancing in the mountain light.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.ice_spikes.desc: Towers of ice tearing through the snowy plain.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.lush_caves.desc: A garden hidden beneath azalea roots.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.basalt_deltas.de: Basalt columns and open lava in the Nether.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.soul_sand_valley: A valley of moaning sand. Blue fire and giant bones.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.crimson_forest.d: Red fungi growing in the Nether's heat.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.warped_forest.de: A blue forest where endermen feel at home.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.rain.desc: Look at the open sky while it rains.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.thunderstorm.des: Fire and Wind tearing the clouds. Look at the sky during a thunderstorm.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.snowfall.desc: Look at the sky while it snows in a cold biome.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.full_moon.desc: The whole moon pours silver light. Look at it on a clear night.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.new_moon.desc: The moonless night, when Shadow is strongest. Look at the sky.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.sunset.desc: The moment Light and Shadow touch. Look at the sky at sunset.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.zenith_sun.desc: The sun at the top of the sky. Look up at noon.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.starry_night.des: Constellations the ancients used as a mana map. Look at the night sky.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.nether.desc: A world of fire and ash. Use the lens anywhere in the Nether.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.the_end.desc: Islands floating in the Void under a starless sky.
Where the four elements exist in their pure state.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.abyss.desc: The depths where Shadow is born.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.celestial_sanctu: A crystal city above the clouds.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.twilight_rift.de: The place between Light and Shadow, where everything ends.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.village.desc: Villagers' simple life has its own magic. Enter a village.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.fortress.desc: Black brick corridors over seas of lava.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.bastion.desc: The golden ruins of the piglins.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.ancient_city.des: A civilization swallowed by the Deep Dark. Tread carefully.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.stronghold.desc: The ancients kept the way to the End here.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.monument.desc: A sunken temple watched by guardians.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.end_city.desc: Purpur towers on the End's far islands.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.mansion.desc: The illagers' lair deep in the dark forest.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.trial_chambers.d: Underground halls made to test adventurers.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.desert_pyramid.d: A temple buried in sand, full of traps.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.ender_dragon.des: Observe the dragon in flight or record the memory after defeating it.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.wither.desc: Observe the Wither or record the memory after defeating it.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.elder_guardian.d: Lord of the ocean monuments. Observe it or defeat it.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.goblin_king.desc: Leader of the goblin villages. Observe it or defeat it.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.ignis.desc: Guardian of Fire. Observe it in battle or record the memory of victory.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.tide_guardian.de: Guardian of Water. Observe it in battle or record the memory of victory.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.primordial_golem: Guardian of Earth. Observe it in battle or record the memory of victory.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.zephyr.desc: Guardian of Wind. Observe it in battle or record the memory of victory.
Lord of the depths. Observe it or record the memory of victory.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.seraph.desc: Guardian of the sky. Observe it or record the memory of victory.
The end of all things. Record the memory of the final battle.
thesis.isekai_mahou.mana_primordial.desc: All magic springs from one source. Link two arcane runes and prove that mana flows.
thesis.isekai_mahou.ignis.desc: Fire consumes in order to create. A Mage who completes this thesis awakens Fire.
thesis.isekai_mahou.aqua.desc: Water shapes even stone. A Mage who completes this thesis awakens Water.
thesis.isekai_mahou.terra.desc: Earth upholds everything. A Mage who completes this thesis awakens Earth.
thesis.isekai_mahou.ventus.desc: Wind has no shape, so it reaches everything. A Mage who completes this thesis awakens Wind.
thesis.isekai_mahou.dualitas.desc: Light and Shadow seem opposed, yet each defines the other. Link them.
thesis.isekai_mahou.convergentia.desc: From Magma to Ice: the four classic elements touch and fuse.
thesis.isekai_mahou.planorum.desc: The Nether's Hellfire and the End's Void: worlds bound by Shadow.
thesis.isekai_mahou.astralis.desc: Stars and dusk write a map of mana across the sky.
thesis.isekai_mahou.magnum_opus.desc: The great arcane theory: all six elements in a single circuit.
